The Edge Index widget provides a static, public signal; Market Pulse offers dynamic market state; Model Court enables interactive reasoning. These primitives form a layered inference system where each builds upon the prior layer’s data model. The API layer abstracts the graph into structured data endpoints, enabling programmatic access. Each widget represents a distinct query mode—static badge, live stream, and conversational interface—each with unique latency and fidelity requirements. Failure modes include API throttling, widget misalignment with data freshness, and conversational hallucination. The system must enforce domain whitelisting, authentication, and usage metering to maintain integrity and monetization.
